applications.proposed_application: The reader should see the programme’s central problem, construction, accepted scope and open obstruction, then enter a complete exposition whose transitions explain why each next object is needed.
applications.verification: Check the outline and actual reading order. Preserve all hypotheses and prove-status distinctions; a beautiful opening cannot replace the full article.

applications.proposed_application: Use a stable programme diagram and a clear local position when entering a branch or result. The local view identifies its place in the whole and returns to that same object.
applications.source_basis: Observed Update sample pp3/7; H3 U1/U2 and amendment D3 are analyst-derived mechanisms.
applications.verification: Every highlighted part must correspond to a real programme object; a locator must not imply an unproved dependency.

applications.surface: Stable identifiers across diagrams and exposition
applications.proposed_application: Use the same object or question identifier in the master figure, section, theorem panel and links. A selected object must reveal the exact corresponding text.
applications.source_basis: Observed Decision Map EN pp16/19; H3 M4/D4 derived from those pages.
applications.verification: Follow representative labels from figure to paragraph and back; verify that repeated identifiers refer to the same mathematical object.

applications.proposed_application: Carry the programme’s actual proof/status distinctions consistently through prose, diagram marks, legend and explorer filters.
applications.source_basis: MC-WR-26/27 and FF-12/33; H3 M5/D5 are a derived visual application.
applications.verification: Read every legend mark literally. Do not reuse business live/coming marks or collapse distinct mathematical statuses.

applications.proposed_application: Use constructions, commutative diagrams, dependency edges, obstruction witnesses or worked examples where they make a precise relationship easier to inspect.

applications.verification: Explain the meaning of every node, edge, arrow and scale; delete decorative stubs, unlabelled hubs and arbitrary meshes.

applications.surface: Complete mathematical prose with meaningful visual structure
applications.proposed_application: Keep conventional article paragraphs, definitions, theorem statements and proofs. Use tables only for genuinely parallel facts and figures for genuine relationships.
applications.source_basis: MC-PAPER-06/07/08; explicit ST-03/DS-01/WR-20 paper exceptions; H2 counter-evidence on density caps.
applications.verification: No load-bearing content is lost to a word cap, visual row system or small type. No commercial ban removes formal mathematical terms.

applications.proposed_application: Check the real overview, article, expanded detail, selected/highlighted branch and relevant empty/error states at the intended viewport sizes. Keep labels, formulas, focus and actions readable.

applications.verification: Verify actual behavior with the existing QA owner. Include keyboard/focus and pointer behavior where present; screenshots alone do not establish functionality.
